entities.name: UUAA-SM procedure
entities.description: UAV authentication and authorization security management procedure performed by the network for UAS services.

entities.name: Re-authentication or re-authorization procedure
entities.description: Network-initiated procedure for re-authenticating or re-authorizing UE supporting UAS services as part of EPS bearer context modification.

entities.name: CAA-level UAV ID
entities.description: UAV identifier provided by UE to network via protocol configuration options for USS communication PDN connection.

entities.name: USS address
entities.description: USS address provided by UE to network via protocol configuration options during attach and PDN connectivity procedures.

entities.name: PDN connection for USS communication
entities.description: PDN connection established for UAS service support communication with USS.

entities.name: UUAA-SM failure during re-authentication/re-authorization
entities.description: Condition when UUAA-SM procedure fails during re-authentication or re-authorization procedure.

entities.name: Revocation of UUAA initiated by network
entities.description: Condition when network initiates revocation of UAV authentication and authorization.

relations.description: Provision of CAA-level UAV ID may trigger network to perform UUAA-SM procedure.
Provision of USS address may be used by network for USS discovery in UUAA-SM context.
After successful UUAA-SM, network may initiate re-authentication/re-authorization procedure.
UUAA-SM failure during re-authentication/re-authorization leads to release of PDN connection for USS communication.
Revocation of UUAA initiated by network leads to release of PDN connection for USS communication.
